data.found_evidence: ddflow claim X (primary checkout, default identity [REDACTED:hostname]-ddflow-7267fe) then ddflow review X --detach in .ddflow/worktrees/X prints: WARNING: X is leased to [REDACTED:hostname]-ddflow-7267fe, and you are [REDACTED:hostname]-X-7267fe: this review is recorded against [REDACTED:hostname]-ddflow-7267fe's item. Tree-derived identity differs by cwd for the same operator, so the lease holder is never the reviewer's identity; the warning fires on every review of every item claimed without --agent.
data.summary: A review started from an item's worktree runs under a different default identity than the claim made from the primary checkout, so it warns that it records against another agent's item
